detail.longDescription: I keep getting this: git -c diff.mnemonicprefix=false -c core.quotepath=false --no-optional-locks fetch --prune --tags --force origin -- Keyboard-interactive authentication prompts from server: ------------------ fatal: protocol error: bad line length character: | Pa FATAL ERROR: Error reading from console: Error 109: The pipe has been ended. Completed with errors, see above. when I try to pull via Sourcetree, and similar errors. When pushing or fetching, I work with the Lorekeeper (v3.0.0) frame/template. I have committed changes done (4). What is it telling me? How can I understand what the errors like these mean? What can I do in future scenarios when I face Sourcetree pull, push, fetch errors like this? What's the solution to this specific issue? I pressed the "launch ssh agent", pressed ok, and the push worked, but I don't know how or why that fixed it. Can anyone explain it to me?
